title: Pixel counter
description: Create an offline pixel-style counter with initial integer 0, button IDs increase/decrease/reset, and an output element ID count showing only the integer. Click adds one, subtracts one, or resets to zero. Support negative numbers. Include labeled keyboard-accessible buttons and README. Use HTML/CSS/JS only, no dependencies or storage. Keep total source under 200 lines.
limitations: Native keyboard behavior and pixel appearance require separate review.
